defect: during a backend exit, after PF_EXITING is set and the kernel has released cmdline and cwd but before the process becomes a zombie, status and start answered 'Backend ownership mismatch; no process was signalled.'
rule: when the cmdline/cwd ownership comparison fails, a pidfile process that is gone, Z or X, has another starttime, or has PF_EXITING (0x4 in /proc/<pid>/stat field 9) counts as stopped; only a live process with the same identity and without PF_EXITING keeps the mismatch; flags that do not parse never count as exiting
unchanged: the identity check used by stop and the meaning of released
the positive path: an exiting process whose cmdline still matches answers running
the pidfile format, every message and every exit code
